handshape: Make a fist with your thumb resting against the side of your hand.
Hold your four fingers straight up together, thumb tucked across your palm.
Curve your fingers and thumb into the shape of the letter C.
Point your index finger up; touch your thumb to the tips of your other curled fingers.
Curl all fingers down so the fingertips rest near the thumb — a loose claw.
Touch your index finger to your thumb forming a circle; other three fingers point up.
Point your thumb and index finger sideways, parallel like a sideways pinch; other fingers curled.
Point your index and middle fingers sideways together; other fingers curled.
Make a fist with only your pinky finger extended upward.
Make the letter I, then trace a J in the air with your pinky.
Hold index and middle fingers up in a V, thumb touching between them.
Extend your thumb and index finger at right angles — an L shape.
Make a fist with your thumb tucked under your first three fingers.
Make a fist with your thumb tucked under your first two fingers.
Curve all fingers to meet your thumb, forming an O.
Like K (index and middle up, thumb between), but pointing downward.
Like G (thumb and index pointing), but pointing downward.
Cross your middle finger over your index finger; others curled.
Make a fist with your thumb resting across the front of your fingers.
Make a fist with your thumb poking up between your index and middle fingers.
Hold your index and middle fingers up together.
Hold your index and middle fingers up in a V (like a peace sign).
Hold your index, middle, and ring fingers up together.
Make a fist, then hook your index finger upward.
Extend your thumb and pinky; curl the rest (like 'hang loose').
Point your index finger and trace a Z in the air.
